def fetch_all_note_summaries(search_query):
    collected = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_access_token, query=search_query, dont_reorder_pinned=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        collected.extend(page)
        if len(page) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return collected
note_summaries = []
queries_tried = []
note_query_used = None
for candidate_query in [note_query, "movie recommendations", ""]:
    if candidate_query in queries_tried:
        continue
    queries_tried.append(candidate_query)
    note_summaries = fetch_all_note_summaries(candidate_query)
    if note_summaries:
        note_query_used = candidate_query
        break
note_details = [apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=summary["note_id"], access_token=simple_note_access_token) for summary in note_summaries]
print({"queries_tried": queries_tried, "query_used": note_query_used, "note_candidates": [{"note_id": note["note_id"], "title": note["title"], "tags": note["tags"], "updated_at": note["updated_at"], "pinned": note["pinned"]} for note in note_details]})

steps.reasoning: Before sending anything, review the retrieved notes against Laura's actual request, select the strongest request-relevant candidate while preserving search rank as a tie-breaker, and normalize its list entries into one comma-separated message.
steps.action_code:
if not note_details:
    raise RuntimeError("No Simple Note candidate was available for Laura's request")
request_relevance_tokens = normalized_tokens(request_text)
scored_notes = []
for candidate_index, note in enumerate(note_details):
    title_and_tags = note["title"] + " " + " ".join(note["tags"])
    title_tag_tokens = normalized_tokens(title_and_tags)
    content_tokens = normalized_tokens(note["content"])
    request_title_overlap = len(request_relevance_tokens & title_tag_tokens)
    request_content_overlap = len(request_relevance_tokens & content_tokens)
    movie_hint = len({"movie", "movies", "film", "films", "cinema", "watch", "recommendation", "recommendations"} & title_tag_tokens)
    relevance_score = 8 * request_title_overlap + 2 * request_content_overlap + 2 * movie_hint
    scored_notes.append((relevance_score, -candidate_index, note))
selected_note = max(scored_notes, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))[2]
raw_lines = [line.strip() for line in selected_note["content"].splitlines() if line.strip()]
movie_titles = []
selected_title_tokens = normalized_tokens(selected_note["title"])
for line_index, raw_line in enumerate(raw_lines):
    line = raw_line.strip()
    was_markdown_heading = line.startswith("#")
    line = line.lstrip("#").strip()
    while line and line[0] in "-*•":
        line = line[1:].strip()
    for number_separator in (". ", ") "):
        prefix, separator, remainder = line.partition(number_separator)
        if separator and prefix.isdigit():
            line = remainder.strip()
            break
    if len(raw_lines) > 1 and line_index == 0:
        first_line_tokens = normalized_tokens(line.rstrip(":"))
        if was_markdown_heading or line.endswith(":") or (first_line_tokens and first_line_tokens == selected_title_tokens):
            continue
        prefix, separator, remainder = line.partition(":")
        if separator and remainder.strip() and normalized_tokens(prefix) & {"movie", "movies", "film", "films", "recommendation", "recommendations", "list"}:
            line = remainder.strip()
    line = line.rstrip(",;").strip()
    if line:
        movie_titles.append(line)
if len(movie_titles) == 1 and ";" in movie_titles[0]:
    movie_titles = [part.strip() for part in movie_titles[0].split(";") if part.strip()]
if not movie_titles:
    raise RuntimeError("The selected note did not yield any movie titles")
recommendation_text = ", ".join(movie_titles)
